about.title: About
about.bio:
I am a Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer and Data Analyst based in Mumbai, with a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. Working at BrinkView LLP, my engineering focuses on the intersection of data architecture, lifecycle automation, and campaign analytics across Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Data Cloud.

On the platform development side, I design and maintain normalized Data Extensions, write complex SQL queries for audience segmentation, and build multi-step journeys in Journey Builder and Automation Studio. On the analytics side, I specialize in connecting disparate CRM datasets, auditing data hygiene, and tracking post-deployment funnel performance to evaluate engagement trends and attribution.

With four Salesforce certifications—including Data360 Consultant and Agentforce Specialist—I focus on scaling marketing operations into Marketing Cloud Next and Data Cloud data graphs, replacing repetitive manual processes with resilient automation, and documenting what I build.

projects.title: MediCare Health Network — MCN POC
projects.tagline: Real-time patient consent capture and automated transactional confirmation architecture in Marketing Cloud Next.

caseStudy.problem: Healthcare inquiry onboarding required immediate patient consent verification with an uncompromised audit trail, zero-latency confirmation delivery, and seamless Contact/Lead deduplication without manual data routing.
caseStudy.whatIBuilt: Engineered an inbound web form ingestion pipeline in Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next. When someone submits the form, the solution looks for an existing Contact with the same email and updates it; if no Contact exists, it looks for an existing Lead with the same email and updates it; if neither exists, it creates a new Lead. The flow records the person's email consent and dispatches an automated transactional thank-you confirmation email.
caseStudy.outcome: Eliminated duplicate Contact and Lead record creation on website form submissions. Fully automated the deduplication and matching sequence, verified email consent logging, and enabled immediate transactional thank-you delivery with zero manual data handling.

projects.title: DreamHomes — Real Estate MCN Implementation
projects.tagline: Dynamic property inquiry gating, junction object modeling, and category-personalized lifecycle journeys.

caseStudy.problem: A real estate landing page enquiry form needed to initiate property-specific email journeys in Salesforce without creating duplicate records or losing property interest context.
caseStudy.whatIBuilt: Constructed an enquiry form and landing page flow. On submission, the solution looks for an existing Contact with matching email and updates it; if none, it matches and updates an existing Lead; if neither exists, it provisions a new Lead. It adds the prospect to the campaign, records email consent, and triggers a property-specific email tailored to their interest (Apartment, Commercial, Plot, or Villa). After a 5-minute wait, it automatically delivers a targeted brochure follow-up for that same property category.
caseStudy.outcome: Streamlined property interest routing without creating duplicate records. Ensured 100% accurate consent capture, campaign attribution, and delivered an automated two-stage personalized nurture sequence within 5 minutes of inquiry.

projects.title: Localization Studio — MCN XLF Translation Tool
projects.tagline: AI-powered XLF localization utility protecting Handlebars tokens, merge variables, and brand glossaries.

caseStudy.problem: Localizing multi-language email Content Variations in Marketing Cloud Next using standard translation tools frequently corrupted Handlebars syntax (e.g. {{Recipient.FirstName}}), broke HTML markup, or translated protected brand nomenclature.
caseStudy.whatIBuilt: Developed a dedicated web application that parses MCN XLF export files, tokenizes and shields all Handlebars expressions and brand glossary terms, translates variations using Google Gemini API prompts with structured schema constraints, and reassembles fully validated XLF packages ready for direct MCN import.
caseStudy.outcome: Achieved a 100% token preservation rate across translated variants, eliminating syntax corruption incidents and reducing multi-language email preparation time from hours to seconds.
